steps.headline: Japan trip planner: flights with price history, the route of cities, and things to see, eat and stay.
steps.hint: It opens on the page. Click a flight option to see its price history (point at the line), click cities along the route, try Change details.
steps.notice: Builder's main gaps: the Pages kit has no status pill, notice, fold, tab strip or spinner, and the only data-heavy sample Page (Money) breaks the guide, so it hand-rebuilt the app's pieces; nothing on charts or "pick a card, see its details" screens; "no light text beside bold" doubled legend and price lines.
steps.risk: All data is made up; the real version needs a flight-price service.
